panels.description: Aggregate receive and transmit utilisation. IF-MIB ifHighSpeed is reported in Mbit/s.

targets.query:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT time, hostname, interface_name, interface_speed_bps, in_octets, out_octets,
         LAG(in_octets) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_in,
         LAG(out_octets) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_out
  FROM fortigate_interfaces
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_range:sqlstring}
    AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring}
    AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring}
    AND hostname LIKE ${device:sqlstring}
), rates AS (
  SELECT time, interface_speed_bps,
         CASE WHEN in_octets >= previous_in THEN (in_octets - previous_in) * 8.0 / 30.0 ELSE NULL END AS receive_bps,
         CASE WHEN out_octets >= previous_out THEN (out_octets - previous_out) * 8.0 / 30.0 ELSE NULL END AS transmit_bps
  FROM samples
)
SELECT time,
       CASE WHEN SUM(interface_speed_bps) > 0 THEN 100.0 * SUM(receive_bps) / (SUM(interface_speed_bps) * 1000000.0) ELSE NULL END AS receive_percent,
       CASE WHEN SUM(interface_speed_bps) > 0 THEN 100.0 * SUM(transmit_bps) / (SUM(interface_speed_bps) * 1000000.0) ELSE NULL END AS transmit_percent
FROM rates
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

targets.query:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT time, hostname, interface_name, in_octets, out_octets,
         LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_time,
         LAG(in_octets) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_in,
         LAG(out_octets) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_out
  FROM fortigate_interfaces
  WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL ${time_range:sqlstring}
    AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring}
    AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring}
    AND hostname LIKE ${device:sqlstring}
), rates AS (
  SELECT time, interface_name,
         CASE WHEN in_octets >= previous_in AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) > 0 THEN (in_octets - previous_in) * 8.0 / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) ELSE NULL END AS receive_bps,
         CASE WHEN out_octets >= previous_out AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) > 0 THEN (out_octets - previous_out) * 8.0 / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) ELSE NULL END AS transmit_bps
  FROM samples
), top_interfaces AS (
  SELECT interface_name, SUM(receive_bps + transmit_bps) AS total_bps
  FROM rates
  GROUP BY interface_name
  ORDER BY total_bps DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT rates.time, rates.interface_name, rates.receive_bps + rates.transmit_bps AS traffic_bps
FROM rates
INNER JOIN top_interfaces ON rates.interface_name = top_interfaces.interface_name
WHERE rates.receive_bps > 0 OR rates.transmit_bps > 0
ORDER BY rates.time
